record.category: inference gateway, free models plus paid credits

free_tier.stated: models whose ID ends in :free are billed Rp 0 and callable with a new account and zero balance; a new account gets 50 requests/day and 5 requests/minute, rising to 1,000/day and 10/minute after a qualifying top-up and unlimited daily with 25/minute on an active plan; a keyless GET /v1/models lists them

record.tooling: an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible key; a built-in kenari-free route picks a free model
record.chaining: pairs with any OpenAI-compatible agent through the free :free models; the scarce link is the 50/day and 5/minute ceiling on a new account

limits.value: new account: 50 requests/day and 5 requests/minute on free models; qualifying top-up raises to 1,000/day and 10/minute; active plan gives unlimited daily and 25/minute
free models run best-effort; exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429

record.binding_note: the 50-per-day and 5-per-minute limit on a new zero-balance account binds first

identity_cost.detail: free registration at kenari.id/login?daftar=1&next=/keys; top-up via QRIS is optional and no credit card is needed for the free models

record.confidence_note: the Indonesian-language free-models page and apex publish the Rp 0 :free suffix and the tiered request limits; exact numbers for a new account come from the apex page

evidence.proved: models ending in :free are billed Rp 0 and callable with a new zero-balance account
evidence.quote: Model yang id-nya berakhiran `:free` ditagih Rp 0. Kamu bisa memanggilnya dengan akun baru dan saldo nol, dalam batas per menit dan batas harian yang naik saat kamu top up atau berlangganan.

evidence.proved: free model limits: 50/day and 5/minute on a new account, rising with top-up or plan
evidence.quote:
Tanpa top up: 50 request per hari, 5 request per menit.
- Sudah top up Rp 10.000: 1.000 request per hari, 10 request per menit.
- Langganan aktif: tanpa batas harian, 25 request per menit.

record.notes: free models are best-effort and the daily/minute ceilings rise with top-up or a plan; the free public catalog is keyless.
